name: Cave Compendium

pages.text: Alex’s Caves native manual; using codices unlocks new categories.

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: The book can be found in Underground Cabins. A shapeless recipe also combines a normal book, Cave Tablet and gold nugget; inspect the active recipe in JEI.

pages.title: Reading
pages.text: Use the book or open it from the mod-manual section. It uses Alex’s Caves own interface. Knowledge belongs to the player: acquiring another physical copy does not make every cave researched.

pages.title: Locked chapter
pages.text: Obtain a codex for that biome and use it to unlock the next knowledge category. Merely opening the book does not consume a codex or perform that research for you.
